old_capture.other_meaning: Family classifier fallback, not proof of missing operator names or unmapped semantic modules.

official_capture.sample_identity_caution: Use retained anonymous sample_id and window; do not invent missing explicit rank joins.

capture_scope.operator_coverage: 32 exported records, two windows x 16 ranks; all model/stream types, not complete request
capture_scope_limits: Frontend CPU traces metadata/envelopes only; external EngineCore sampling separately recorded.
Actual NPU snapshots about 2s, capacity fields are not bandwidth.
MIX includes communication and distinct labels are not separate additive phases.

limits: These are rechecks of existing derived aggregates, not independent raw trace reconstruction.
Call counts may be summed for conservation; durations across ranks/windows/types are not additive request critical-path time.
Old profile, official two-window capture, and166 observer values must not be joined as same-call evidence.
Family/type names and matching shapes do not establish tensor identity, alias versions or legal numerical reassociation.
Profile-only phase/branch absence does not prove a configured path is impossible.
